title: Annual Reward Certificates on Northgate Memberships
content:
## Issue

On the last day of each membership year of Northgate Memberships held at a tier with a non-zero Annual Reward rate, the Annual Reward balance is converted into a certificate for its full value when it is at least the tier's minimum certificate amount; a smaller balance is not issued and carries into the next membership year.

A certificate is issued only on a membership whose status is active or expired; the balance of a cancelled, suspended or closed membership is not converted.

| Status on the year's last day | Balance converted |
|---|---|
| active | Yes, when at least the minimum certificate amount |
| expired | Yes, when at least the minimum certificate amount |
| cancelled, suspended or closed | No |

## Redemption

A certificate is redeemable at any club register as tender, or toward the renewal of the same membership under the membership fee charging rules, until the tier's certificate validity period (in calendar months) after the reward year's end. Redemption at a register needs a membership that is active, while a renewal of the same membership may use it even if that membership has expired.

## Lost or undelivered certificates

An unredeemed certificate the member reports lost or never received is voided and reissued for the same value and expiry. A lost certificate is reissued only when the reissue is requested no later than the tier's certificate validity period, in calendar months, after the end of the reward year it was issued for. Calendar months are added to the reward year's end date and, when the resulting month has no such day, the boundary falls on that month's last day; the boundary day itself is still in time. A certificate is reissued at most as many times as the tier allows, counted from the reissues already recorded against that original certificate.

### Boundary cases (hypothetical dates, 12-month validity)

| Reward year ended | Last day a reissue may be requested | Requested on | Reissued |
|---|---|---|---|
| 31 August 2026 | 31 August 2027 | 31 August 2027 | Yes, if reissues remain |
| 31 August 2026 | 31 August 2027 | 1 September 2027 | No |
| 29 February 2028 | 28 February 2029 (no 29th) | 28 February 2029 | Yes, if reissues remain |

## Expired certificates

An expired certificate has no value and is never reissued, extended or paid out.
